source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    gaps = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = row[c - 1]
            if color and row[c] == 0 and row[c + 1] == color:
                gaps.append((r, c, color))
    for r, c, color in gaps:
        out[r][c] = color
        rr = r - 1
        while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
            out[rr][c] = color
            rr -= 1
    for c in range(w):
        r = h - 1
        while r >= 0:
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                r -= 1
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            end = r
            while r >= 0 and grid[r][c] == color:
                r -= 1
            start = r + 1
            isolated = all((cc == 0 or grid[rr][cc - 1] == 0) and (cc == w - 1 or grid[rr][cc + 1] == 0) for rr in range(start, end + 1))
            if isolated:
                rr = start - 1
                while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
                    out[rr][c] = color
                    rr -= 1
    return out
'''
